title: AWS KMS and Vercel OIDC Infrastructure Template

transitions.note: Created after live Vercel readiness probe showed AWS_REGION present but role/KMS/OIDC runtime configuration absent.
Prepare reproducible CloudFormation infrastructure only; no AWS account mutation is possible through connected tools.

CloudFormation template passed cfn-lint. IAM/KMS policy review confirmed project-specific Vercel trust, separate preview/production roles, exact KMS resource scope, encryption-context constraints and no static AWS credentials.
Reproducible AWS KMS/Vercel OIDC infrastructure definition completed. Live AWS deployment remains external because no AWS mutation connector is available.

notes: Completed IaC and deployment runbook. Vercel readiness probe showed AWS_REGION present while AWS_ROLE_ARN, AI_CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID and VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN were absent; static AWS credentials were also absent. Template validation passed cfn-lint.
